takeaway: PetClinic is one Spring Boot web app with two functional areas, Owners & Pets and Veterinarians, both persisting through JPA to one relational database (H2 by default, MySQL or PostgreSQL by profile).

elements.name: Clinic user (browser)
elements.responsibility: Uses the HTML pages; no authentication or roles in the code

elements.name: PetClinic web application
elements.responsibility: Single Spring Boot deployable (Spring MVC + Thymeleaf + Spring Data JPA)

elements.name: Owners & Pets
elements.responsibility: Find/register/edit owners, add/edit pets, book visits (package owner: 3 controllers, 2 repositories, entities)

elements.name: Veterinarians
elements.responsibility: Read-only vet list as HTML page and JSON/XML resource, cached in JCache cache 'vets'

elements.name: Clinic database
elements.responsibility: Relational store; schema and seed data per database under db/<database>/

where data is kept and which stores are supported
